name: sentifix-smoke
description: Live smoke dataset over THIS repo — expectedFiles are real Sentifix paths, so `pnpm embed:ab --repo <sentifix> --dataset sentifix-smoke` yields genuine recall numbers. Not a production dataset.

issue.title: Reranker should fall back to retrieval order when the LLM returns invalid JSON
issue.body: The precision-stage reranker scores each candidate chunk for relevance with an LLM and keeps the top-N. If the model returns malformed JSON the whole triage must not break — it should log a warning and fall back to the original retrieval order. Where is the reranker service that does pointwise relevance scoring and top-N selection?

issue.title: Code chunking splits functions in half instead of respecting boundaries
issue.body: Indexing should chunk source files on language-aware separators (function, class, def, func) so a small function stays intact and only oversized functions are split, with overlap. Which module implements the recursive character splitter with per-language separators?

issue.title: Compute recall@k, precision@k and MRR for retrieval evaluation
issue.body: The offline eval harness needs component-level retrieval metrics comparing retrieved file paths against ground-truth expected files, with fuzzy path matching. Where are recallAtK, precisionAtK and reciprocalRank defined?

issue.title: LLM-as-judge should use a separate model and reference-based scoring
issue.body: The eval judge grades a proposed diff across correctness/completeness/safety/clarity. It should support scoring against a reference solution and use a different judge model than the chat model to avoid self-preference bias. Which file implements the judge?

issue.title: Prioritize stack-trace files and expand neighbouring chunks
issue.body: Retrieval should move chunks whose file matches a stack-trace file or a classifier-flagged component to the front, and pull adjacent chunks around a hit so the LLM sees whole functions. Where is the structural prioritization and neighbour planning logic?
